name: XP Rate Customization
description: Kill / Quest / Explore XP multipliers in mangosd.conf.
notes: Three keys and no more: mangos-classic sets Rate.XP.Kill at `src/game/World/World.cpp:422`
and has no per-tier `.Vanilla` / `.BC` twins at all. The TBC manifest's note about those
is a fact about that fork and does not apply here (read on ~/vanilla-75b, 2026-09-08).
The anchors are load-bearing on THIS tree in a way they are not on TBC: `Rate.Pet.XP.Kill`
ships two lines above `Rate.XP.Kill` (`etc/mangosd.conf:1509-1510`), so an unanchored
`Rate\.XP\.Kill` would rewrite the pet rate and nothing would report it.
The remove patches restore the shipped column alignment, which is why they carry the
spacing rather than a single space: the conf comes back byte-identical.
